}}'''Jadranka''' was an officer in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jadranka}}

== Appearance==
He was a short thin man with a prominent nose.

== Activities ==
He is part of [[Furyk Karede]] troop that engage [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces on their campaign into [[Illian]]. He questions Karede's order about retreating when their force is being destroyed by [[Asha'man]] and is killed by Karede in mid-sentence.
